data.content:
Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [Shockingly horrible quality](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/693311461e9edd0a72191eba)
I bought the Brooke 5-drawer dresser for $1600 plus $250 shipping. The first time it arrived damaged, so it was sent back before it even came into the house. When the new one arrived, I was honestly shocked by the horrible quality. The drawers don't extend all the way so it's hard to get to the back, they aren't soft close (I should have checked the description), and the quality of the drawers is what I would expect from Target or Walmart. It just feels like junk. So we're faced with a 15% restocking fee, plus shipping it back plus losing the $250 we paid for white glove delivery (plus what I tipped the men who came). That's over $700 with nothing to show for it. The company doesn't even list a phone number, so you can't talk to a live person. I will never again buy from this company.

December 1, 2025

Unprompted review

* * *

1

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Dec 8, 2025

Hi Una,

Thank you for sharing your feedback about your recent experience and we sincerely apologize for any disappointment with your Brooke 5-Drawer Dresser. We understand how frustrating it can be when an item does not meet your expectations. While our standard freight return policy is to deduct both the restocking fee and original shipping, we have made a one-time exception for your case and will waive both these fees as store credit, which never expires. Please respond to our ongoing email thread if you'd like to move forward with this return, and let us know if you have any other questions. We appreciate your understanding and are happy to help.
